boundary: If the notice carried only the tax identifier and no adverse remark about the employee, Privacy / Confidentiality alone would be right; the negative performance note sent to external partners adds Reputational / Social / Psychological.
factor: adverse personal remark about an identifiable person carried in disclosed content
note: The assessor stated the performance note but wrongly claimed the disclosure is the sole harm; that unsupported claim, which the blind audit marks as label-changing, dropped the reputational label.
